title: Younger Forever: A SuperAger’s Guide to Life After 50
description: From the New York Times bestselling creator and coauthor of the Younger Next Year series comes Younger Forever: A SuperAger’s Guide to Life After 50 . Chris Crowley took his own advice twenty-five years ago, and it has paid off handsomely. At ninety-one, he is a SuperAger, a category these days among serious students of longevity. Crowley believes being a SuperAger is mostly a matter of living longer and having more fun, which he has certainly done. He is still skiing the black diamonds in Aspen, has written eight books since turning seventy, and leads a vigorous social life. He is also fit and healthy. With his signature wit and long knowledge of successful aging and wellness, he tells us how he got there. He also reports on new things he learned along the way, some of them quite surprising. Exercise, relentless optimism, and intense connection with others are at the core of his experience and advice. But he also takes a deep dive into aspects of retired life that others don’t talk about. A big one: figuring out what to do all day, now that you’re retired. Having something serious to do—something that uses your best gifts but leaves plenty of time for play—is critical and not easy. There’s the amusing business of getting funny looking as you age and what to do about it. Also, what about your leaky bladder? Your vanishing sex drive? The fact that you put your hat in the refrigerator the other day? Humor, optimism, and good spirits count for a lot, and he brings them all. There are bumps in the road, but if you know they’re coming and take some steps, the Third Act can be a joy…perhaps the best in the whole play. title: Young Forever: The Secrets to Living Your Longest, Healthiest Life (The Dr. Mark Hyman Lib
description: Bestselling author Dr. Mark Hyman presents the definitive guide for reversing disease, easing pain, and living younger longer. Aging has long been considered a normal process. We think disease, frailty, and gradual decline are inevitable parts of life. But they’re not. Science today sees aging as a treatable disease. By addressing its root causes we can not only increase our health span and live longer but prevent and reverse the diseases of aging—including heart disease, cancer, diabetes, and dementia. In Young Forever , Dr. Mark Hyman challenges us to reimagine our biology, health, and the process of aging. To uncover the secrets to longevity, he explores the biological hallmarks of aging, their causes, and their consequences—then shows us how to overcome them with simple dietary, lifestyle, and emerging longevity strategies. You’ll learn how to optimize your body's key longevity switches; reduce inflammation and support the health of your immune system; exercise, sleep, and de-stress for healthy aging; and eat your way to a long life, featuring Dr. Hyman's Pegan Diet. You’ll also get exclusive insight from Dr. Mark Hyman on which supplements are right for you, where the research on aging is headed, and so much more. description: Learn how to live longer, be healthy, happy, and socially more connected. Aging is inevitable and our death is certain. But we may increase our life span and live a longer productive life contributing more to society and the whole world. It is not limited to a certain category of people in some places; rather anyone can increase their longevity by understanding the biological process of aging, what separates the young and old person, and how the inner child’s desire can be reignited. Do you take care of your parents and grandparents? Can you understand their physical difficulties and mental problems? Do you want to help them to live longer? Are you a septuagenarian or octogenarian or above? Can you feel the constraints in your movements and expectations? As a normal human being, could you ever think what may be your life expectancy? Why you cannot live beyond 100 years? What are the common causes of death and how those can be overcome? How can you avoid an early death in your life? When you see a premature death, do you think it must be avoided and how to stop its recurrence? Do you feel any economic gain, if people live longer, stay happy and productive? Do you believe, it is possible? If you are concerned about such things, then this book is for you. Learn from this book, The common causes of death, diseases that are predominant in old age and how those can be reversed and/or prevented with self-care practices and proven techniques What diets to take to live a long life with a strong immunity system What are the exercises that can be taken up by elderly people How to de-stress oneself and how to sleep well to regenerate the body Why mental wellness is important while taking care for physical health How psychological well-being plays a key role in living a longer life

description: "The breakthrough book we've been waiting for on . . . epigenetics and aging . . . Does your family come from a long line of Alzheimer's, cancer, or heart disease? Will nothing help your aging skin or declining libido or flagging energy? This book is for you. The assumption is that we are our genes. The scientific reality is that ninety percent of the signs of aging and disease are caused by lifestyle choices, not your genes. In other words, you have the capability to overcome and transform your genetic history and tendencies. Harvard/MIT-trained physician Sara Gottfried, M.D. has created a revolutionary seven-week program that empowers us to make the critical choices necessary to not just look young, but also feel young. Dr. Gottfried builds this book around the five-key factors that lead to accelerated aging —the muscle factor, the brain factor, the hormone factor, the gut factor, and the toxic fat factor. The seven-week program addresses these factors and treats them in an accessible and highly practical protocol and is as follows: Feed—Week 1 Sleep—Week 2 Move—Week 3 Release—Week 4 Expose—Week 5 Soothe—Week 6 Think—Week 7 Dr. Gottfried's program makes it possible to change the way you age, stay younger longer, and remain healthy and vibrant for all of your days. title: Younger You: Reduce Your Bio Age and Live Longer, Better
description: Discover an accessible plan to prevent disease and reduce your biological age with this groundbreaking and informative book. It’s true: getting older is inevitable and your chronological age can only move in one direction. But you also have a biological age, which scientists can measure by assessing how your genes are expressed through epigenetics. Exciting new research shows that your bio age can actually move in reverse. By eating delicious foods and establishing common-sense lifestyle practices that positively influence genetic expression, study participants have reduced their bio age by just over three years in only eight weeks! Now Dr. Kara Fitzgerald shares the diet and lifestyle plan that shows you how to influence your epigenetics for a younger you. In Younger You you’ll learn: How your epigenetics determine your age and level of health How DNA methylation powerfully influences your epigenetic expression The foods and lifestyle choices that most affect DNA methylation Simple swaps to your daily routines that will add years to your life Recipes and meal plans to reduce your bio age and increase vitality How to take care of your epigenetic expression at every stage of your life We don’t have to accept a descent into disease and unwellness as we age as inevitable. With assessment tools for determining your bio age, recipes, and plans for putting it all into practice,Younger You helps you repair years of damage, ward off chronic disease, and optimize your health—for years to come.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5"]', '#CardInstance10pqsIq_ywq4q5cCO6_iaw')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_5',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#

description: Hannah Can your first love be your one great love? Can your high school sweetheart be your soulmate? Is it possible to find the person you’re meant to spend the rest of your life with so early in life? These are the questions that plague my heart. Ford and I were destined for a great romance until our parents stepped in the way and forced us apart. We’ll do as they ask and try to stay away, but being apart only makes our love for each other stronger. Trying to live my best life is impossible without him beside me, but I’m trying to live in the moment and make my life count for something good. Even if I must wait until June to be with the guy I love. Ford Is it possible to love a person so much that you can hardly breathe without them? If you truly love a person, is it better for my heart to break, and let them be free instead of holding too tight? Is she better off without me? These are the questions that keep me up at night. I finally signed with a college to play football. Only it’s bittersweet since I can’t share it with the girl I love. Being apart from her is more complicated than I imagined until Hannah proposes a solution to our problems. It’s not a good idea, but it’s getting harder and harder for us to stay away from each other. This may be our chance to do things the way we want.
